title: Lattice-Based Characterizations and Inference for Multivariate Dependence
summary: We develop a measure-theoretic framework for conditional multivariate total positivity of order two ($\mathrm{cmMTP}_2$), formulated through lattice inequalities without requiring the existence of probability densities. This formulation extends classical density-based notions of positive dependence to general probability measures, including singular distributions. We establish fundamental preservation properties under marginalization, monotone transformations, and weak convergence, thereby providing a unified treatment of dependence structures under distributional limits.
